title: Materuni Waterfall and a Coffee Tour Near Moshi
excerpt: Above Moshi lies the village of Materuni, with a tall waterfall and small coffee farms. A perfect day before or after your climb or safari.
body:
Materuni is a Chagga village on the lower slopes of Kilimanjaro, about 30 to 45 minutes by car from Moshi. It combines two of the nicest things to do in the area: a waterfall walk and a coffee experience.

## The waterfall

From the village a path leads through farms and forest to the Materuni waterfall, which drops from a high cliff into a pool. The walk takes about 45 minutes each way and can be slippery after rain. Brave visitors swim in the cold pool.

## The coffee experience

At a local family farm you see the whole process: picking ripe coffee cherries, removing the husks, roasting the beans over a fire and grinding them by hand, often with songs. Then you drink the coffee you made yourself. Read more about [Tanzanian coffee](/blog/tanzanian-coffee/).

## About the Chagga

The Chagga have farmed the slopes of Kilimanjaro for centuries, growing bananas and coffee. Read about [the Chagga people](/blog/chagga-culture-kilimanjaro/).

## Practical

- Wear shoes with grip.
- Bring swimwear if you want to swim.
- A guide from the village leads the walk; the fee supports the community.

## When to go

It works well on your arrival day, as a rest day before the climb or after the safari.

[Add Materuni to your trip](/travel-proposal/).
